Title: fix(invites): flag existing members on the invite row before submit

## Problem

- People who invite a teammate who is already in the organization, or themselves, get a generic toast after a round trip. It happens in onboarding and in organization settings.
- The client checks only the email format. The server rejects existing members in `OrganizationInviteSerializer.create`, which runs during `save()`.
- In the bulk endpoint, `save()` creates rows in order. A batch with an existing member in row 3 already saved and emailed rows 1 and 2 before it failed.
- Each failure goes to error tracking as a handled exception, which makes a validation result look like a defect.

## Origin

- Scout: a custom scout
- First signal: 2026-09-25
- Inbox report: [open]([ref]
- Task started by: auto-start, after the report was rated P2 and ready to fix
tasks.goldTitle: fix(invites): flag existing members on the invite row before submit

Title: feat(workflows): let a live broadcast go back to draft and replace its schedule on launch

- Follow-up to [[ref]]([ref] whose review flagged both: the lost stop control ([thread]([ref] and the paused schedule ([thread]([ref]

Title: fix(experiments): keep inline and shared metric uuids unique

## Problem

- A shared metric attached to an experiment could share a uuid with an inline metric, so one metric showed the other's results.

Title: fix(experiments): fingerprint saved metrics with their per-experiment breakdowns ## Problem Users whose saved metrics carry per-experiment breakdowns still see their experiment recompute on every first open of the day, even after [ref]. The daily job computes each metric and files the result under a hash of the metric's config. 2. For a saved metric, the breakdowns live on the experiment link, not in the saved query itself. 3. Title: fix(flags): skip non-v1 configs in cross-team flag jobs

## Problem

- One team's feature flag stored in a config format the v1 readers do not understand could make a job that scans every team's flags rewrite that row, misreport it, or abort the whole run.
- Three such jobs read `filters` as a v1 document with no format check: the payload re-encryption command, the read-only filters audit, and the weekly stale-flags health check. A fourth, the property-type repair command, has no work left and is deleted instead.
- No such rows are stored today; this closes the path before the first one lands, as the internal cache builders ([ref]) and the legacy definitions producer ([ref]) already did for their paths.
tasks.goldTitle: fix(flags): skip non-v1 configs in cross-team flag jobs

Title: fix(warehouse-sources): pause cdc table schedules on break and disable

## Problem

- A team that disables CDC on a source keeps paying for syncs of its former CDC tables.
  `disable_cdc` turns the tables off with a bulk `update(sync_type=None, should_sync=False)`. That skips `update_should_sync`, the helper that pauses a table's Temporal schedule, and `ExternalDataJobWorkflow` never checks `should_sync`. So each table keeps syncing, as a billable run, on its old schedule.
- A broken CDC source (slot dropped for critical lag, slot or publication missing) keeps starting runs for every CDC table.
  `mark_cdc_broken` pauses only the capture schedule. Each table's schedule keeps firing, and every tick records a failed or billing-blocked job until someone repairs the source.
tasks.goldTitle: fix(warehouse-sources): pause cdc table schedules on break and disable

Title: feat(error-tracking): name the assignee in issue alert events

## Problem

- People building error tracking alerts on destinations cannot show who an issue is assigned to, because the payload holds only a user or role id.
- Issue lifecycle events carry `assignee` as a JSON string, for example `{"type":"user","id":1234}`. The key is missing when the issue is unassigned.
- Hog templates cannot resolve that id to a person, so a message can say "assigned" or "unassigned" and nothing more.
- The alert authoring skill reference does not mention the assignee, so PostHog AI guesses at its shape.
tasks.goldTitle: feat(error-tracking): name the assignee in issue alert events
